notes.title: PLAYTEST #6 HOTFIX #7
notes.content:
BALANCE

 Teleport - Cooldown reduced to 12 from 24
 Phase Walk - Cooldown reduced to 15 from 19
 Fly - Cooldown increased to 28 from 24
 Parry - duration increased to 0.5s from 0.25s

notes.title: PLAYTEST #6 HOTFIX #6
notes.content:
NEW FEATURES

Shotgun - Added UI element to display shells loaded.

BALANCE

Sniper

 Speed - reduced to 35 from 40
 Damage - distance damage multiplier has been increased, however after reaching 30 damage the multiplier is lowered significantly. The result is reaching 30 damage requires less distance, but damage scaling is lowered at that point. Maximum damage of Sniper is now 60 up from 40


AUDIO CHANGES

Shotgun - on hit SFX changed and volume lowered substantially

notes.title: PLAYTEST 6 HOTFIX 4 - 5/13/25
notes.content:
PLAYTEST #6 EXTENSION

Servers will be available until Sunday May 18th, cut off time is 5PM EST

During this extension, I will not be advertising focused testing. So, feel free to play with friends, but finding a lobby alone is unlikely.

Expect random hotfixes and additions to the game throughout the week.

NEW CHANGES

Parry - E Hotkey by Default - within .25s any damage taken will be reduced by 50% - 5 Second CD.
Parry is a baseline ability that every player has.

BUG FIXES

Player not passing Moon on death - this big is assumed to be fixed. Please let me know if this bug still occurs in your games.
Lag Spike at the start of 1st round should no longer occur.

Shotgun - Should now properly display that you are reloading. While reloading you cannot cast other spells.
